palette: Pale blue-silver metal with cloud-gray shadows and restrained azure seams.
valueRange: Light, high-clarity metal values without becoming white.
surfaceAndWear: Unusually smooth light metal, wind-swept polish lines, crisp edges, sparse abrasion.
constructionVocabulary: Long sweeping profiles, lightened apertures, winglike ribs, elegant thin reinforcement.
supernaturalBehavior: A faint cool sheen gathers on upward edges as if catching open-sky light.
neutralSecondaryMaterials: Slate leather, pale hardwood, silver fittings, and gray cloth.
neighborDifference: Lighter, more open, and more graceful than Blacksteel; less cosmic and faceted than Starmetal.
